full_page.content:
1928, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 22 Cont.
Mrs. Siess - pain & lump in side
(Laethem & Williams) - to be married next Tuesday 22 - He was threatened with serious hemoraging was enrolled, 11th. positively improving now. Prayers-
York Case .... Mr. - Mrs. & 5 Child. Alice Funke - Threatened tubercl's Mrs. Sadie Yaklin, dying of cancer Dr. Conley - in Receiving Hosp. (Wm. Alpin) - drinking & gambling
Mrs. Rivard - 4 children - cancer - operated on last Sat. - next Sat.
Page 23
Mrs. Anna McComb. St. Anne Queb. - 8 children - frightened 6 yrs. ago and lost her mind - prayers are asked
Miss Carroll - $7000. house saved Thanks! ! ! .
Mrs. Nicholson, of Kingston Ont. Mother of Rev. Fr. N. - Very sick & Helpless .....
Mrs. Wilkenson - sore lip .. Fears - cancer or something else.
Baby ( 15 mo. ) Marg. Giblin to have 5th transfusion To-day. Was Enrolled month ago - susprised doctors.
Little Smuzyusk - 1 yr. - 7 mo. - very bad gland -
Page 24 May 30th
(Mrs. Ag. Parish ( 11042 Gratian) left orphan at 16 with 9 little brothers and sister to mother ... married at 19 in hopes .... Husband now for 14 yrs. an invalid
John Poppoff - (W. Warren) - 24 - 9 mo. married - non Cath. - Very sick.
